prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and whether you need full-service support or a specialty (SEO, paid media, content, product/UX growth, B2B demand-gen, e‑commerce, etc.).

To help you quickly, tell me:
- Primary goal (sales, leads, brand awareness, app installs, etc.)
- Main channels you care about (SEO, paid search, social, content, email, CRO)
- Industry (SaaS, e‑commerce, healthcare, fintech, consumer, etc.)
- Monthly budget (ballpark)
- Timeline and KPIs that matter

If you’d rather not specify, here’s a short checklist to evaluate any SF agency and questions to ask when you interview them:
- Case studies and results for similar clients (request metrics: CPA, LTV, conversion rate uplift)
- Experience in your industry and with the channels you need
- Team structure and who will do the work vs. who will sell it
- Reporting cadence, KPIs, and dashboard access
- Pricing model (retainer, percentage of ad spend, project) and minimums
- Contract length, exit terms, and onboarding plan
- References from current or recent clients

Interview questions:
- Can you show a 90-day plan for achieving our top KPI?
- What tools and reporting will we get?
- Who will be our day-to-day contact, and what’s their background?
- How do you optimize creative and what’s your A/B testing process?
- Give an example of a client where you missed goals — what changed?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 5 reputable San Francisco agencies tailored to your answers, or
- Provide a shortlist by specialty (e.g., top SF agencies for B2B SaaS growth, or top SF e‑commerce paid-media shops).

Which do you prefer?
